mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates growing consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) both show signs of growth, it suggests a robust supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both increase > 1% in 6 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.
